scope.market_definition: The Rehabilitation Products Market encompasses a range of products designed to assist in the recovery and rehabilitation of patients with physical impairments. Key participants include manufacturers, distributors, wholesalers, resellers, system integrators, and service providers operating globally.

value_chain_layers.description: This layer involves the distribution of rehabilitation products from manufacturers to end-users through various channels.
This layer includes service providers and system integrators who offer installation and support services for rehabilitation products.

# Bioness Integrated Therapy System, now with Immersive Functional Reality

Discover a new world of rehabilitation with BITS Functional Reality (BITS FR), designed to support
patients in their recovery.

[Learn about BITS FR][56]

# New Pathways. New Possibilities.

Portable Neuromodulation Stimulator (PoNS), is an innovative, non-surgical treatment option that
helps people with MS or chronic stroke symptoms improve their walking.

[Learn about PoNS][57]

# Improved Mobility. Made Easier.

The L300 Go system uses functional electrical stimulation (FES) to help correct foot drop and thigh
weakness. The system stimulates the nerves and muscles that lift the foot to walk more naturally.

[Learn about L300 Go][58]

# Muscle Movement, Maximized

The L360 Thigh System uses neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) and functional electrical
stimulation (FES) to address muscle weakness by helping to strengthen leg muscles, improve knee
stability, and prevent or slow muscle loss due to disuse.

[Learn about L360][59]

# Freedom and function are within reach

The H200 Wireless Hand Rehabilitation System uses functional electrical stimulation (FES) to improve
hand function so users can get back to activities of daily living.

[Learn about H200 Wireless][60]

# Developed by therapists, for therapists

The Vector Gait and Safety System is a ceiling-mounted robotic system that supports a patient’s body
weight during rehabilitation activities. Vector gives patients confidence while allowing clinicians
to focus on performance and outcomes.

[Learn about Vector][61]

# Rehab’s #1 Multidisciplinary Therapy Solution Just Got EVEN Better.

The Bioness Integrated Therapy System (BITS) is a software-based therapy platform that uses an
interactive touchscreen display to challenge, assess, and track a patient’s deficiencies in vision,
cognition, and balance.

[Learn about BITS][62]

# Motion That Matters

The first and only bilateral upper-extremity exoskeleton designed to reflect natural human movement
and enable high-intensity functional therapy.

In development. Not for sale.

[Learn about AURA][63]

# Dynamic Body Weight Support for Real-World Movement

Haloplex is intended for real-world, omni-directional movement during therapy. Built on a proven
foundation and delivered as part of a comprehensive rehab program.

In development. Not for sale.

[Learn about Haloplex][64]

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

[Robust Product Selection]

# Rebuilding Shattered Lives

Victims of negligence need to be able to rely on the law for help

Injured people need support to help them put their lives back together

Anyone could become a victim of negligence – it could happen to you

[Find out more][87]

# What is APIL?

Over the years APIL has grown to become the leading, most respected organisation in this field,
constantly working to promote and develop expertise in the practise of personal injury law, for the
benefit of injured people.

The Association of Personal Injury Lawyers:
* Believes passionately that victims deserve committed, well trained lawyers to support their fight
  for justice;
* Understands that injured people can often be the most vulnerable in society and need help;
* Campaigns to make a tangible difference to the lives of injured people and society as a whole;
* Reassures victims and acts fairly with honesty and integrity;
* Drives up standards in personal injury law and process, encouraging innovation and efficiency;
* Is ‘not for profit’ and does not seek to make money out of the misfortune of injured people;
* Treats law as a rewarding vocation, not a job, and encourages its members to thrive in their work.

APIL’s head office in Nottingham is the base for 25 dedicated full and part time staff who are
responsible for running the day-to-day activities of the organisation, including campaigns, press
and media work, and the development of training and conference programmes.

# Home Biose

# Your microbiome partner
# for health and well-being
# Microbiome. Manufacturing. Mastered.

From strains to finished products, Biose Industrie manufactures microbiome solutions for
pharmaceutical and non-pharmaceutical markets, supporting projects from development to commercial
supply.

##### Biose

## BIOSE INDUSTRIE

Biose Industrie is a specialised microbiome CDMO supporting biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and
consumer-focused companies across Live Biotherapeutic Products (LBPs), Next-Generation Probiotics
(NGPs), consumer health, consumer care, and cosmetics.

We combine deep aerobic and anaerobic microbiology expertise, industrial scale, and robust GMP
quality systems to take projects from development to commercialisation.

##### Vision

## Vision

Our vision is to build a future where the potential of micro-organisms strengthens and enhances
health and well-being, across regulated pharmaceutical applications and everyday consumer solutions.

##### Identity

## Identity

A pioneer in pharmaceutical microbiology since 1951, Biose Industrie operates two complementary
businesses serving a wide range of industries:

### CDMO Services

An international CDMO specialised in Live Biotherapeutic Products (LBPs) and Next-Generation
Probiotics (NGPs), from process development to GMP drug product manufacturing.

### Strains, Ingredients & Finished Products

Supplier of microbiome-based ingredients and finished products under private label for the health,
nutrition, wellness, and cosmetic markets.

##### Mission

## Mission

Our mission is to contribute to the success and satisfaction of our clients by delivering
micro-organism-based solutions — ingredients, finished products, and dedicated developments — driven
by scientific excellence, industrial performance, and anticipation of regulatory and market
evolutions.

### What is CheckerTR PRO?

CheckerTR PRO is an all-in-one GSM repair toolkit for professional technicians. It covers IMEI
repair, FRP bypass, data recovery, and flashing for most Android brands.

### Which brands are supported?

We support Samsung, Xiaomi, MediaTek, Qualcomm, Huawei, Oppo, Realme, Infinix, Tecno, and many other
brands with dedicated service modules.

# OUR MISSION

COPE’s mission is to help people with mobility-related disabilities move on by supporting access to
physical rehabilitation services in the Lao PDR.

[Watch Video][24]

** The COPE Visitor Centre is open **

[Visit Us][25]

PEOPLE WE’VE HELPED MOVE ON

#### ["Patou" Noudaeng][26]

After my accident I had the idea of fabricating my home-made wooden leg. But it was very heavy and
not comfortable!

#### [Mr. Thongsing][27]

Because of my disability, I thought I would never marry. But luckily I found one girl in my village
who loved me as I was, and together we had two sons and built a family.

#### [Ms. Leu][28]

I love to help my father farming our fruit garden. We have so many “chan-chan” trees, it’s a
specialty from our region and it’s very tasty!

#### [Mr. Xieun][29]

I love to cultivate my garden. I am planning to plant organic vegetables, so that everyone in my
family can eat fresh and healthy vegetables.

#### [Mr. Mai][30]

I’ve always been careful about UXOs. However, one day my arm was suddenly snatched away from me.

#### [Mr. Yia Yang][31]

I have so many ducks and chickens. But my pride is my beautiful cow. She is my favorite!

#### [Mr. Siafong][32]

I never thought I would have two arms again!

#### [Vin][33]

My passion is playing football, but what I really want is to become a nurse so I can help other
people with disabilities like me.

# WHAT WE DO

Since its creation in 1996, COPE’s work has helped thousands of people with mobility-related
disabilities, including UXO survivors, access prosthetic and orthotic services, allowing them to
regain mobility and dignity.

We enable access to:
* Prosthetic devices
* Orthotic devices
* Other mobility assistive devices
* Clubfoot treatment
* Physiotherapy and occupational therapy
* Related surgical procedures

# OUR MISSION

COPE’s mission is to help people with mobility-related disabilities move on by supporting access to
physical rehabilitation services in the Lao PDR.

[Watch Video][24]

** The COPE Visitor Centre is open **

[Visit Us][25]

PEOPLE WE’VE HELPED MOVE ON

#### ["Patou" Noudaeng][26]

After my accident I had the idea of fabricating my home-made wooden leg. But it was very heavy and
not comfortable!

#### [Mr. Thongsing][27]

Because of my disability, I thought I would never marry. But luckily I found one girl in my village
who loved me as I was, and together we had two sons and built a family.

#### [Ms. Leu][28]

I love to help my father farming our fruit garden. We have so many “chan-chan” trees, it’s a
specialty from our region and it’s very tasty!

#### [Mr. Xieun][29]

I love to cultivate my garden. I am planning to plant organic vegetables, so that everyone in my
family can eat fresh and healthy vegetables.

#### [Mr. Mai][30]

I’ve always been careful about UXOs. However, one day my arm was suddenly snatched away from me.

#### [Mr. Yia Yang][31]

I have so many ducks and chickens. But my pride is my beautiful cow. She is my favorite!

#### [Mr. Siafong][32]

I never thought I would have two arms again!

#### [Vin][33]

My passion is playing football, but what I really want is to become a nurse so I can help other
people with disabilities like me.

# WHAT WE DO

Since its creation in 1996, COPE’s work has helped thousands of people with mobility-related
disabilities, including UXO survivors, access prosthetic and orthotic services, allowing them to
regain mobility and dignity.

We enable access to:
* Prosthetic devices
* Orthotic devices
* Other mobility assistive devices
* Clubfoot treatment
* Physiotherapy and occupational therapy
* Related surgical procedures

## **Premium Medical Equipment Manufacturing: Why Genemax is Your Trusted Partner in Taiwan**

Looking for a reliable **medical equipment manufacturer**? Since 1992, **Genemax Medical Products
Industry Corp.** has been a global leader in the design and production of high-quality medical
devices. **Made in Taiwan**, our products leverage the country’s world-class manufacturing
technology and strict quality control standards.

### **The Genemax Advantage**
* **Certified Taiwanese Manufacturing:** Our Taiwan-based facility ensures every medical device
  meets international safety and durability standards.
* **Innovative R&D & OEM/ODM Services:** We provide cutting-edge solutions and customizable
  manufacturing to meet the evolving needs of the healthcare market.
* **30+ Years of Industry Expertise:** We bridge the gap between local excellence and global demand,
  delivering tailored medical solutions for international distributors.
* **Diverse Product Portfolio:** We specialize in **manual and electric wheelchairs, home care beds,
  walkers, mobility scooters, commodes,** and **rehabilitation equipment.**

Partner with a dedicated **Taiwanese medical supplier** committed to excellence. Whether you are a
healthcare provider or a medical equipment distributor, Genemax offers the reliability your business
deserves.

**Contact us today for wholesale inquiries and partnership opportunities.**

You’re in Safe Hands

Speech therapy focuses on improving a child's general language and communication skills. It may be
aimed at treating delays or speech disorders, reducing or eliminating stuttering, and even feeding
and swallowing because all of these factors influence a child's ability to communicate.

[Quality-Care-for-Seniors.jpg]

Service You Can Trust

requires immediate attention. At Holmes to Homes Health & Rehabilitation Services, we offer around

Contact us today and learn how you can benefit from our Rehabilitation Therapy services.

## About Us

Our Mission is to optimally enable persons with Locomotor Disabilities by quality interventions that
go beyond their medical needs and to provide him/her need based comprehensive rehabilitation through
team approach facilitating inclusion, ensuring empowerment of their families and by substantiating
field based research and development of human resources, so as to achieve their social and economic
independence, train Rehabilitation Professionals and undertake Research.

To actualize the potential of every person with locomotor disability and to ensure him/her equal
opportunities, equal rights to lead a qualitative life to protect their rights and full
participation in the society, with committed professionalism, accessible environment, positive
attitudes and appropriate, affordable, acceptable and available technological interventions.

## Navigate change. Decode demand. Grow with confidence.

Markets are changing faster than most planning cycles. Technology, regulation, supply chain shocks
and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools
are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

## Our Strategic Process

We connect market signals to revenue decisions through a simple, repeatable flow.

### Market Signals

Track macro trends, policy shifts, technology disruption and competitive moves.

### Strategic Insights

Convert data into clear narratives on risk, growth pockets and profit pools.

### Actionable Strategies

Translate insight into prioritised initiatives, investments and go to market plays.

### Revenue Impact

Execute with confidence and measure the effect on growth, margin and resilience.

## Our Core Capabilities

## Market Sizing and Forecasting

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

[Read More about Market Sizing and Forecasting][48]
[Market Sizing and Forecasting]

## Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

[Read More about Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis][49]
[Competitive intelligence illustration showing business analytics]

## Customer, Channel and Use Case Insights

Our Customer, Channel & Use Case Insights reveal what drives adoption, loyalty, and value creation.
We analyse customer behaviours, channel economics, and real-world use cases to identify the
segments, routes to market, and opportunities that matter most-helping organizations sharpen their
strategy and unlock sustainable, high-quality growth.

Granular understanding of how customers discover, select, purchase and use products and services
across channels. We identify which needs are under served and which features or propositions
actually drive choice.

[Read More about Customer, Channel and Use Case Insights][50]

### What we can offer

Technomex delivers efficient and ergonomic rehabilitation solution. For over 35 years we've been
helping our customers from rehabilitation hospitals and small rehabilitation centers to simplify
their daily responsibilities, focus on a patient and increase effectiveness of therapy.
We use technology to help you!

[
[Functional training with Virtual Reality ACX.Rehab]

#### Functional training with Virtual Reality ACX.Rehab

Concept of active treatment in virtual reality combining proven classical methods of therapy with
the possibilities of innovative technology.

][102]
[
[Robotic Assisted Gait Therapy]

#### Robotic Assisted Gait Therapy

Advanced robotic-assisted gait therapy device based on the end-effector principle.

][103]
[
[Hydrotherapy]

#### Hydrotherapy

Hydrotherapy as a branch of physiotherapy is understood as therapy in water environment. In this
category you'll find wide range of hydrotherapy devices.

][104]
[
[Kinesiotherapy]

#### Kinesiotherapy

Kinesiotherapy is defined as “treatment by movement”. It includes wide scope of therapeutical
activities. In this category you'll find rehabilitation tables and devices for active training.

][105]
[
[Cryotherapy]

#### Cryotherapy

During the treatment with physicaltherapy devices are used physical phenomena (eg. low temperature)
for therapeutic purposes.

][106]
[
[COVID-19]

#### COVID-19

The experience of pandemic has affected everybody worldwide. In this category you'll find protection
solution.

][107]

This toolkit contains resources and tools to facilitate organizational transformation away from
sheltered employment and non-work services and towards integrated employment and community life
supports.

## [What People with IDD Want You to Know about HCBS Waiver Employment Services][55]

This Research to Practice brief examines the perspectives of people with IDD and their families on
Medicaid HCBS waiver employment services through focus groups and interviews. The study explores
experiences with employment supports, service delivery systems, and funding structures, identifying
key barriers and opportunities to improve access to meaningful integrated employment. Findings
highlight the importance of high-quality, person-centered services, improved coordination across
systems, stable and skilled…
[Read More][56]

## [Using Self-Directed Transportation Services to Support Competitive Integrated Employment][57]

Self-directed transportation services can help people with intellectual and developmental
disabilities (IDD) overcome one of the biggest barriers to competitive integrated employment:
getting to work.

[Read More][58]

intellectual and developmental disabilities (IDD) who receive services through state IDD systems.

The world needs more resilient and sustainable infrastructure. Traditional rehabilitation and
installation methods involve intensive digging and high costs.

At Vortex, we anticipate problems, imagine solutions, and develop no-dig, trenchless technologies to
solve big infrastructure problems — cost-effectively and permanently.

[ Our Products ][65] [ Our services ][66]
A world of trenchless rehabilitation products to address any project – materials, liners, robots,
equipment and more.

cured-in-place liners delivered wet or dry across the Americas. [Visit Site][67]
The largest provider of small diameter CIPP liners and supporting equipment. Whether in-building,
laterals or patching, MaxLiner has a total solution to complete any project. [Visit Site][68]

# Bioness Integrated Therapy System, now with Immersive Functional Reality

Discover a new world of rehabilitation with BITS Functional Reality (BITS FR), designed to support
patients in their recovery.

[Learn about BITS FR][56]

# New Pathways. New Possibilities.

Portable Neuromodulation Stimulator (PoNS), is an innovative, non-surgical treatment option that
helps people with MS or chronic stroke symptoms improve their walking.

[Learn about PoNS][57]

# Improved Mobility. Made Easier.

The L300 Go system uses functional electrical stimulation (FES) to help correct foot drop and thigh
weakness. The system stimulates the nerves and muscles that lift the foot to walk more naturally.

[Learn about L300 Go][58]

# Muscle Movement, Maximized

The L360 Thigh System uses neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) and functional electrical
stimulation (FES) to address muscle weakness by helping to strengthen leg muscles, improve knee
stability, and prevent or slow muscle loss due to disuse.

[Learn about L360][59]

# Freedom and function are within reach

The H200 Wireless Hand Rehabilitation System uses functional electrical stimulation (FES) to improve
hand function so users can get back to activities of daily living.

[Learn about H200 Wireless][60]

# Developed by therapists, for therapists

The Vector Gait and Safety System is a ceiling-mounted robotic system that supports a patient’s body
weight during rehabilitation activities. Vector gives patients confidence while allowing clinicians
to focus on performance and outcomes.

[Learn about Vector][61]

# Rehab’s #1 Multidisciplinary Therapy Solution Just Got EVEN Better.

The Bioness Integrated Therapy System (BITS) is a software-based therapy platform that uses an
interactive touchscreen display to challenge, assess, and track a patient’s deficiencies in vision,
cognition, and balance.

[Learn about BITS][62]

# Motion That Matters

The first and only bilateral upper-extremity exoskeleton designed to reflect natural human movement
and enable high-intensity functional therapy.

In development. Not for sale.

[Learn about AURA][63]

# Dynamic Body Weight Support for Real-World Movement

Haloplex is intended for real-world, omni-directional movement during therapy. Built on a proven
foundation and delivered as part of a comprehensive rehab program.

In development. Not for sale.

[Learn about Haloplex][64]

# Bioness Integrated Therapy System, now with Immersive Functional Reality

Discover a new world of rehabilitation with BITS Functional Reality (BITS FR), designed to support
patients in their recovery.

[Learn about BITS FR][56]

# New Pathways. New Possibilities.

Portable Neuromodulation Stimulator (PoNS), is an innovative, non-surgical treatment option that
helps people with MS or chronic stroke symptoms improve their walking.

[Learn about PoNS][57]

# Improved Mobility. Made Easier.

The L300 Go system uses functional electrical stimulation (FES) to help correct foot drop and thigh
weakness. The system stimulates the nerves and muscles that lift the foot to walk more naturally.

[Learn about L300 Go][58]

# Muscle Movement, Maximized

The L360 Thigh System uses neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) and functional electrical
stimulation (FES) to address muscle weakness by helping to strengthen leg muscles, improve knee
stability, and prevent or slow muscle loss due to disuse.

[Learn about L360][59]

# Freedom and function are within reach

The H200 Wireless Hand Rehabilitation System uses functional electrical stimulation (FES) to improve
hand function so users can get back to activities of daily living.

[Learn about H200 Wireless][60]

# Developed by therapists, for therapists

The Vector Gait and Safety System is a ceiling-mounted robotic system that supports a patient’s body
weight during rehabilitation activities. Vector gives patients confidence while allowing clinicians
to focus on performance and outcomes.

[Learn about Vector][61]

# Rehab’s #1 Multidisciplinary Therapy Solution Just Got EVEN Better.

The Bioness Integrated Therapy System (BITS) is a software-based therapy platform that uses an
interactive touchscreen display to challenge, assess, and track a patient’s deficiencies in vision,
cognition, and balance.

[Learn about BITS][62]

# Motion That Matters

The first and only bilateral upper-extremity exoskeleton designed to reflect natural human movement
and enable high-intensity functional therapy.

In development. Not for sale.

[Learn about AURA][63]

# Dynamic Body Weight Support for Real-World Movement

Haloplex is intended for real-world, omni-directional movement during therapy. Built on a proven
foundation and delivered as part of a comprehensive rehab program.

In development. Not for sale.

[Learn about Haloplex][64]

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include

# Rebuilding Shattered Lives

Victims of negligence need to be able to rely on the law for help

Injured people need support to help them put their lives back together

Anyone could become a victim of negligence – it could happen to you

[Find out more][87]

# What is APIL?

Over the years APIL has grown to become the leading, most respected organisation in this field,
constantly working to promote and develop expertise in the practise of personal injury law, for the
benefit of injured people.

The Association of Personal Injury Lawyers:
* Believes passionately that victims deserve committed, well trained lawyers to support their fight
  for justice;
* Understands that injured people can often be the most vulnerable in society and need help;
* Campaigns to make a tangible difference to the lives of injured people and society as a whole;
* Reassures victims and acts fairly with honesty and integrity;
* Drives up standards in personal injury law and process, encouraging innovation and efficiency;
* Is ‘not for profit’ and does not seek to make money out of the misfortune of injured people;
* Treats law as a rewarding vocation, not a job, and encourages its members to thrive in their work.

APIL’s head office in Nottingham is the base for 25 dedicated full and part time staff who are
responsible for running the day-to-day activities of the organisation, including campaigns, press
and media work, and the development of training and conference programmes.

# What is APIL?

Over the years APIL has grown to become the leading, most respected organisation in this field,
constantly working to promote and develop expertise in the practise of personal injury law, for the
benefit of injured people.

The Association of Personal Injury Lawyers:
* Believes passionately that victims deserve committed, well trained lawyers to support their fight
  for justice;
* Understands that injured people can often be the most vulnerable in society and need help;
* Campaigns to make a tangible difference to the lives of injured people and society as a whole;
* Reassures victims and acts fairly with honesty and integrity;
* Drives up standards in personal injury law and process, encouraging innovation and efficiency;
* Is ‘not for profit’ and does not seek to make money out of the misfortune of injured people;
* Treats law as a rewarding vocation, not a job, and encourages its members to thrive in their work.

APIL’s head office in Nottingham is the base for 25 dedicated full and part time staff who are
responsible for running the day-to-day activities of the organisation, including campaigns, press
and media work, and the development of training and conference programmes.

##### Biose

## BIOSE INDUSTRIE

Biose Industrie is a specialised microbiome CDMO supporting biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and
consumer-focused companies across Live Biotherapeutic Products (LBPs), Next-Generation Probiotics
(NGPs), consumer health, consumer care, and cosmetics.

We combine deep aerobic and anaerobic microbiology expertise, industrial scale, and robust GMP
quality systems to take projects from development to commercialisation.

##### Vision

## Vision

Our vision is to build a future where the potential of micro-organisms strengthens and enhances
health and well-being, across regulated pharmaceutical applications and everyday consumer solutions.

##### Identity

## Identity

A pioneer in pharmaceutical microbiology since 1951, Biose Industrie operates two complementary
businesses serving a wide range of industries:

### CDMO Services

An international CDMO specialised in Live Biotherapeutic Products (LBPs) and Next-Generation
Probiotics (NGPs), from process development to GMP drug product manufacturing.

### Strains, Ingredients & Finished Products

Supplier of microbiome-based ingredients and finished products under private label for the health,
nutrition, wellness, and cosmetic markets.

##### Mission

## Mission

Our mission is to contribute to the success and satisfaction of our clients by delivering
micro-organism-based solutions — ingredients, finished products, and dedicated developments — driven
by scientific excellence, industrial performance, and anticipation of regulatory and market
evolutions.

# Home Biose

# Your microbiome partner
# for health and well-being
# Microbiome. Manufacturing. Mastered.

From strains to finished products, Biose Industrie manufactures microbiome solutions for
pharmaceutical and non-pharmaceutical markets, supporting projects from development to commercial
supply.

##### Biose

## BIOSE INDUSTRIE

Biose Industrie is a specialised microbiome CDMO supporting biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and
consumer-focused companies across Live Biotherapeutic Products (LBPs), Next-Generation Probiotics
(NGPs), consumer health, consumer care, and cosmetics.

We combine deep aerobic and anaerobic microbiology expertise, industrial scale, and robust GMP
quality systems to take projects from development to commercialisation.

##### Vision

## Vision

Our vision is to build a future where the potential of micro-organisms strengthens and enhances
health and well-being, across regulated pharmaceutical applications and everyday consumer solutions.

##### Identity

## Identity

A pioneer in pharmaceutical microbiology since 1951, Biose Industrie operates two complementary
businesses serving a wide range of industries:

### CDMO Services

An international CDMO specialised in Live Biotherapeutic Products (LBPs) and Next-Generation
Probiotics (NGPs), from process development to GMP drug product manufacturing.

### Strains, Ingredients & Finished Products

Supplier of microbiome-based ingredients and finished products under private label for the health,
nutrition, wellness, and cosmetic markets.

##### Mission

## Mission

Our mission is to contribute to the success and satisfaction of our clients by delivering
micro-organism-based solutions — ingredients, finished products, and dedicated developments — driven
by scientific excellence, industrial performance, and anticipation of regulatory and market
evolutions.

## Become One of the Faces of CHRISTUS

Join a team that extends the healing ministry of Jesus Christ and creates innovative health and
wellness solutions for individuals and communities. Join a company that values dignity, integrity
and compassion, and where you can grow and deliver quality health care.

[Hispanic woman in a suit with mid-length brunette hair smiling at the camera. ]
Associates

At CHRISTUS Health we value you, for you. We know the work you do will make a difference. Join our
family of caregivers, build your career at CHRISTUS and you’ll develop meaningful relationships
while you positively impact lives in our communities.

[ Become a CHRISTUS Associate ][117]
[Happy CHRISTUS nurse smiling into the camera with maroon scrubs on]
Nursing

Nurses are the heart of the CHRISTUS Health family. Whether you are a seasoned nurse, or a new grad,
you will find a wealth of opportunity at CHRISTUS. We care for our nurses – providing excellent
benefits, educational opportunities, shift differentials, clinical ladder programs and more -- so
our nurses can focus on care for our patients. The perfect nursing position is waiting for you.

[ Become a CHRISTUS Nurse ][118]

# OUR MISSION

COPE’s mission is to help people with mobility-related disabilities move on by supporting access to
physical rehabilitation services in the Lao PDR.

[Watch Video][24]

** The COPE Visitor Centre is open **

[Visit Us][25]

PEOPLE WE’VE HELPED MOVE ON

#### ["Patou" Noudaeng][26]

After my accident I had the idea of fabricating my home-made wooden leg. But it was very heavy and
not comfortable!

#### [Mr. Thongsing][27]

Because of my disability, I thought I would never marry. But luckily I found one girl in my village
who loved me as I was, and together we had two sons and built a family.

#### [Ms. Leu][28]

I love to help my father farming our fruit garden. We have so many “chan-chan” trees, it’s a
specialty from our region and it’s very tasty!

#### [Mr. Xieun][29]

I love to cultivate my garden. I am planning to plant organic vegetables, so that everyone in my
family can eat fresh and healthy vegetables.

#### [Mr. Mai][30]

I’ve always been careful about UXOs. However, one day my arm was suddenly snatched away from me.

#### [Mr. Yia Yang][31]

I have so many ducks and chickens. But my pride is my beautiful cow. She is my favorite!

#### [Mr. Siafong][32]

I never thought I would have two arms again!

#### [Vin][33]

My passion is playing football, but what I really want is to become a nurse so I can help other
people with disabilities like me.

# WHAT WE DO

Since its creation in 1996, COPE’s work has helped thousands of people with mobility-related
disabilities, including UXO survivors, access prosthetic and orthotic services, allowing them to
regain mobility and dignity.

We enable access to:
* Prosthetic devices
* Orthotic devices
* Other mobility assistive devices
* Clubfoot treatment
* Physiotherapy and occupational therapy
* Related surgical procedures

[Find Out More][34]

Local Home Care Experts Here to Serve You

You’re in Safe Hands

Speech therapy focuses on improving a child's general language and communication skills. It may be
aimed at treating delays or speech disorders, reducing or eliminating stuttering, and even feeding
and swallowing because all of these factors influence a child's ability to communicate.

[Quality-Care-for-Seniors.jpg]

Service You Can Trust

requires immediate attention. At Holmes to Homes Health & Rehabilitation Services, we offer around
the clock medical home care services to ensure that our clients get the attention they deserve.
Contact us today and learn how you can benefit from our Rehabilitation Therapy services.

services across Cardiac Sciences, Heart & Lung Transplantation, Liver Care, Gastro Sciences,
Neurology, Neurosurgery, Orthopaedics, Obstetrics & Gynaecology, ENT – Head & Neck Surgery, Hernia
Surgery, Rehabilitation Medicine and Emergency Medicine. Our Centres of Excellence bring together
experienced specialists, advanced diagnostics and multidisciplinary expertise to deliver
personalised care for patients with both common and complex medical conditions.

 

Supported by advanced medical technology and evidence-based treatment, MGM Healthcare is committed
to delivering safe, compassionate and high-quality healthcare. From preventive health check-ups to
complex surgeries and organ transplantation, our team focuses on improving patient outcomes through
coordinated, patient-centred care.

## About Us

Our Mission is to optimally enable persons with Locomotor Disabilities by quality interventions that
go beyond their medical needs and to provide him/her need based comprehensive rehabilitation through
team approach facilitating inclusion, ensuring empowerment of their families and by substantiating
field based research and development of human resources, so as to achieve their social and economic
independence, train Rehabilitation Professionals and undertake Research.

To actualize the potential of every person with locomotor disability and to ensure him/her equal
opportunities, equal rights to lead a qualitative life to protect their rights and full
participation in the society, with committed professionalism, accessible environment, positive
attitudes and appropriate, affordable, acceptable and available technological interventions.

The world needs more resilient and sustainable infrastructure. Traditional rehabilitation and
installation methods involve intensive digging and high costs.

At Vortex, we anticipate problems, imagine solutions, and develop no-dig, trenchless technologies to
solve big infrastructure problems — cost-effectively and permanently.

Condition Assessment

rehabilitation to restore your pipe, manhole or structure.

Manhole Rehabilitation

Why dig up your deteriorated manholes when you can fully rehabilitate and restore them through
trenchless means. We offer several full structural and corrosion resistant options.

][78] [
Pipe Bursting

With millions of feet of pipe bursting under our belts, we are able to not only replace your damaged
sewer and water pipe, but we can also upsize them at the same time.

][79] [
CIPP Lining

The most proven out of all forms of trenchless pipe rehabilitation, we offer CIPP lining services to
address gravity sewer and pressure, as well as watermain renewal in a broad range of diameters.

][80] [
Geopolymer Pipe Lining

From 36” OD and up, and just about any size or shape sewer structure, our geopolymer lining services
are the most experienced in the industry. Featuring GeoKrete® Geopolymer, rest assured your
structures will be restored to full structural integrity, with corrosion resistance to boot.

][81] [
Vertical & In-Building Rehab

Our trenchless services extend to vertical, in building applications as well. Let us help you
determine the most cost-effective and non-disruptive method of restoring vertical stack and vent
lines along with plumbing lines embedded in your building.

Industrial

Our industrial services division provides trenchless pipe rehab services to restore industrial sewer
and process lines, manholes and other structures on properties that have been impacted by corrosive
materials. Understanding Safety is of the utmost importance, our crews are certified for work in
